newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian schools likely to reopen soon - minister.
newsitem.headline: Albanian schools likely to reopen soon - minister.

text.p: Albania's Education Minister said he expected the country's schools and universities, closed since a wave of armed violence swept the country, could reopen in about 10 days.
Minister Luan Skuqi told reporters schools in areas under the control of the government would reopen first, probably on April 21.
He hoped those in other parts of Albania, such as the south which has been under the control of armed rebels, could be reopened by the end of April or early May.
"We have co-operated with the Interior Ministry and we plan to restart classes after April 20 in all towns where police have the situation under their control," he said on Thursday evening.
He estimated about $500,000 damage had been done to schools, mainly in the towns of Fier, Vlore, Gjirokaster, Sarande, Lac and Korce.
Skuqi said he hoped schools in the rebel-held southern port of Vlore would reopen by early May.
The military academy was the first school to reopen last week.
